For the Head Study Prefect, roster generation, fairness checks, and leave adjustments are therefore not tools of control, but entrusted acts of care, order, and peace.
en.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep this before me: I am called not to be served, but to serve.

Centres authority on Christlike service, sacrifice, fairness, and care.

zh.title: 願為首，先作眾人的用人
zh.body: 耶穌坐下教導十二門徒，表明這不是一句口號，而是門徒群體必須學會的國度秩序。想走在前面的人，要先學會走到最後，承擔別人不願承擔的責任。對導學風紀而言，真正的「為首」是先守規矩、先顧及公平、先願意多走一步。
zh.prayer: 主啊，使我願意先作眾人的用人，然後才談領導。

en.title: First by Becoming Servant of All
en.body: Jesus sits down to teach the Twelve, showing that this is not a slogan but a kingdom order His disciples must learn. The one who desires to be first must become last of all and servant of all, taking up responsibilities others may avoid. For study prefect leadership, being first means first to keep the rules, first to protect fairness, and first to go the extra mile.
en.prayer: Lord, make me willing to become servant of all before I speak of leading.

en.title: Serving Christ by Following Christ
en.body: Jesus joins service to discipleship: whoever serves Him must follow Him. We cannot borrow His name while refusing His way. The way of Christ includes humility, obedience, self-denial, and faithfulness in small things. If a Head Study Prefect serves for the Lord, he remains dependable when unseen and willing when service costs something.
en.prayer: Lord, let my service not merely carry Your name, but truly follow Your way.

notes: Clarifies that Christian service is discipleship, not merely helpful activity.

en.title: Gladly a Servant to All
en.body: Paul is free in Christ, yet he willingly limits himself in order to serve more people. This is not a loss of dignity; it is the gospel freeing him from self-centredness. A student leader needs the same freedom: not controlled by pressure or personal preference, but gladly adjusting himself for the good of the community.
en.prayer: Lord, give me gospel freedom to serve willingly for the good of others.

en.body: Paul refuses to turn ministry into self-display: he proclaims Christ Jesus as Lord and himself as a servant for Jesus' sake. This corrects every form of leadership. The role is not a stage, and service is not a way to build personal reputation. When coordinating duties or maintaining order, the Head Study Prefect should reveal truth, humility, and dependable love more than personal ability.
en.prayer: Lord, make me less eager to display myself and more faithful to show Christ.

en.body: Ephesians teaches that ordinary duties can become service before the Lord. If we work only for human praise, the heart quickly becomes tired or calculating; if we know we serve before Christ, even checking, reminding, waiting, and tidying carry spiritual weight. This keeps a leader honest when unseen and willing when the work is tedious.
en.prayer: Lord, help me remember that faithfulness in ordinary duties is offered to You.

en.body: First Timothy lists character qualifications for overseers, reminding us that spiritual leadership cannot be separated from life. A student role is not the same as church office, yet the principle matters: respectability, self-control, gentleness, and the ability to manage oneself. If the Head Study Prefect is to be trusted, ability must be supported by character.
en.prayer: Lord, shape my character so my ability is governed by You.

en.body: Titus warns that leaders must not be self-willed or quick-tempered, but just, holy, and self-controlled. Pressure reveals the heart: mistakes, lateness, and disagreement can expose stubbornness and anger. A leader governed by God learns to pause, correct himself, and then address the issue with fairness and restraint.

en.prayer: Lord, teach me to care for those who cannot repay me.

scripture.zh: 不從惡人的計謀， 不站罪人的道路， 不坐傲慢人的座位， 惟喜愛耶和華的律法， 晝夜思想他的律法； 這人便為有福！ 他要像一棵樹栽在溪水旁， 按時候結果子， 葉子也不枯乾。 凡他所做的盡都順利。
scripture.en: Blessed is the man Who walks not in the counsel of the ungodly, Nor stands in the path of sinners, Nor sits in the seat of the scornful; But his delight is in the law of the LORD, And in His law he meditates day and night. He shall be like a tree Planted by the rivers of water, That brings forth its fruit in its season, Whose leaf also shall not wither; And whatever he does shall prosper. (NKJV)

zh.title: 扎根主話，按時結果
zh.body: 詩篇第一篇描寫有福的人，不隨從惡人的道路，卻喜愛耶和華的律法，像樹栽在溪水旁。僕人領袖若只靠壓力、技巧或人的肯定，很快枯乾；若扎根於神的話，就能在合宜時候結出穩定、公義、忍耐和愛的果子。持久的服事先從隱密的根開始。
zh.prayer: 主啊，使我扎根於祢的話，按時結出服事的果子。

en.title: Rooted in the Word, Fruitful in Season
en.body: Psalm 1 describes the blessed person who refuses the path of wickedness and delights in the law of the Lord, like a tree planted by streams of water. A servant leader who depends only on pressure, technique, or approval will soon dry out; one rooted in God's Word can bear the fruit of steadiness, justice, patience, and love in season. Durable service begins with hidden roots.
en.prayer: Lord, root me in Your Word so my service bears fruit in its season.

notes: Links long-term leadership sustainability to Scripture-shaped roots.

scripture.zh: 「你們是地上的鹽。鹽若失了味，怎能叫它再鹹呢？它不再有用，只好被丟在外面，任人踐踏。 你們是世上的光。城造在山上是不能隱藏的。
scripture.en: “You are the salt of the earth; but if the salt loses its flavor, how shall it be seasoned? It is then good for nothing but to be thrown out and trampled underfoot by men. “You are the light of the world. A city that is set on a hill cannot be hidden. (NKJV)

zh.title: 不可隱藏的城
zh.body: 耶穌說門徒像山上的城，不能隱藏。領袖位置也有這種公開性：人的語氣、準時、公平、是否願意補位，都會成為別人觀察的見證。因此導學風紀不只是完成任務，更是在日常秩序中顯明基督門徒的品格，使人看見光而歸榮耀給天父。
zh.prayer: 主啊，使我的日常服事成為清潔明亮的見證。

en.title: A City That Cannot Be Hidden
en.body: Jesus says His disciples are like a city set on a hill; they cannot be hidden. Leadership has the same public quality: tone, punctuality, fairness, and willingness to fill gaps all become visible witness. Study prefect service is therefore more than completing tasks; it displays the character of a disciple in ordinary order, so others may see light and give glory to the Father.
en.prayer: Lord, make my daily service a clean and steady witness to Your light.

notes: Distinct salt-and-light reflection emphasizing visible witness through everyday leadership.
